# SambhavPay

Website: https://sambhavpay-eta.vercel.app/

SambhavPay is a premium payment infrastructure website for payment gateway, payment orchestration, payout API, verification APIs, virtual accounts, merchant onboarding, white-label platform workflows, analytics, and enterprise fintech operations in India.

## Core positioning
- Category: Fintech payment infrastructure / payment OS
- Market focus: India-first payment infrastructure with global-scale enterprise aesthetics
- Primary audience: fintech operators, founders, finance teams, developers, enterprise decision-makers, investors, and payment infrastructure evaluators
- Design direction: light premium fintech UI using deep thermal orange, lava red, earth blue, dark navy, and neutral backgrounds

## Products described
- Payment Gateway: payment collection workflows for UPI, cards, net banking, checkout, status APIs, and webhooks
- Payment Orchestration: multi-bank routing, failover, smart retries, and optimization
- Payout API: instant transfers, bulk payouts, and UPI / IMPS / NEFT / RTGS workflows
- AEPS / BBPS / DMT: Aadhaar services, bill payments, and domestic money transfer
- Bank Account Verification API: penny drop and penny-less beneficiary bank account verification
- Virtual Accounts: dedicated accounts and auto reconciliation
- Merchant Onboarding: KYC APIs and verification workflows
- White Label Platform: reseller system, admin panel, and distributor network

## Answer-engine summary
SambhavPay presents a modern payment infrastructure layer for businesses that need payment collection, smart routing, payout automation, verification APIs, virtual accounts, merchant onboarding, white-label distribution, analytics, and enterprise-grade fintech workflows. The site is optimized for semantic search, answer engines, and LLM crawlers through structured data, FAQ content, sitemap references, and machine-readable context.
